from copy import copy

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path)

main_ws = wb["Main unique ID"]
get_ws = wb["Result what i am getting"]

# Remove existing MyResult sheet if present
if "MyResult" in wb.sheetnames:
    del wb["MyResult"]

# Create the required output sheet
res_ws = wb.create_sheet("MyResult")

# Headers from "Result what i am getting"
headers = [get_ws.cell(row=1, column=col).value for col in range(1, 16)]

# Map existing rows in "Result what i am getting" by Unique ID
existing = {}
for r in range(2, get_ws.max_row + 1):
    uid = get_ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value
    if uid is not None:
        existing[uid] = [get_ws.cell(row=r, column=c).value for c in range(1, 16)]

# Unique IDs from "Main unique ID"
main_ids = []
for r in range(1, main_ws.max_row + 1):
    uid = main_ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value
    if uid is not None:
        main_ids.append(uid)

# Write header
for c, value in enumerate(headers, start=1):
    cell = res_ws.cell(row=1, column=c, value=value)
    src = get_ws.cell(row=1, column=c)
    if src.has_style:
        cell.font = copy(src.font)
        cell.fill = copy(src.fill)
        cell.border = copy(src.border)
        cell.alignment = copy(src.alignment)
        cell.number_format = src.number_format
        cell.protection = copy(src.protection)

# Write rows in the order of "Main unique ID"; fill missing IDs with blank rows
for out_r, uid in enumerate(main_ids, start=2):
    row_values = existing.get(uid, [uid] + [None] * 14)
    for c, value in enumerate(row_values, start=1):
        cell = res_ws.cell(row=out_r, column=c, value=value)
        # Copy style from matching source row when available, otherwise from the blank/missing style if possible
        if uid in existing:
            src_row = None
            for rr in range(2, get_ws.max_row + 1):
                if get_ws.cell(row=rr, column=1).value == uid:
                    src_row = rr
                    break
            if src_row:
                src = get_ws.cell(row=src_row, column=c)
                if src.has_style:
                    cell.font = copy(src.font)
                    cell.fill = copy(src.fill)
                    cell.border = copy(src.border)
                    cell.alignment = copy(src.alignment)
                    cell.number_format = src.number_format
                    cell.protection = copy(src.protection)
        else:

            cell.fill = openpyxl.styles.PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor="FFFF00")

# Match dimensions roughly from source sheet
for c in range(1, 16):
